definitions.explanation: The act of nurturing and raising a child, providing food, shelter, education, and care until they can be independent.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもを{養育|よういく}する{義務|ぎむ}がある。
examples.english: There is an obligation to raise the child.

examples.japanese: {養育|よういく}{費|ひ}を{毎月|まいつき}{払|はら}っている。
examples.english: I pay child support every month.

examples.japanese: {離婚後|りこんご}の{養育|よういく}{権|けん}について{話|はな}し{合|あ}った。
examples.english: We discussed custody rights after the divorce.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {養育|よういく}{費|ひ}: child support payments
- {養育|よういく}{権|けん}: custody (rights to raise a child)
- {養育|よういく}{環境|かんきょう}: child-rearing environment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {育児|いくじ}: childcare (day-to-day care, especially of young children)
- {子育|こそだ}て: raising children (everyday, colloquial)
- {養護|ようご}: protection and care (used in institutional contexts)
